title: Monthly management close
context: Financial Controller closing the February 2026 management accounts of a fictional furniture maker. One observed session.
origin: Curated synthetic candidate for the hackathon (fictional data). Not approved: review every step in the desk.

evidence.text: Reports > GL detail export. Period 2026-02, accounts 4000 to 6999. Export started for 01/02/2026 - 28/02/2026.
Error: request timed out after 120 s. Export not completed.
Searched mail for 'export timing out'. Opened Mark Fallon's email of 27 Feb: export 1-14 and 15-end of month separately and merge, do not paste the boundary day twice.

Exported 01/02-14/02 and 15/02-28/02. Merged into gl_2026-02.csv: 50 rows, columns entry_id, posting_date, period, journal, account, account_name, cost_centre, counterparty, document_ref, description, debit, credit.
closing_workbook_2026-02.xlsx, tab GL_import: deleted January rows, pasted 50 February rows. Formulas in columns M (line_code) and N (net) copied down.
Tab Mapping checked: filter column M on UNMAPPED in GL_import returns 0 rows. All accounts mapped.
Check: sum of net in GL_import matches the ERP P&L total for February. OK.
Tab PnL_vs_Budget refreshed. EBITDA actual 312,800 vs budget 324,000.
Filter comment needed = YES: 1 line. Timber & panels -11,600.
GL_import filtered on account 5000 and counterparty Brightwood Timber Ltd: 3 invoices BW-INV-10588, BW-INV-10631, BW-INV-10690, description 'price list 2026-02', total 156,600.00.
Searched mail for 'Brightwood'. Found E01 (Brightwood price list +8% from 1 February) and E02 (Niamh: about EUR 12k a month, rebate requested).
Opened news site during the close. Not related to the procedure.
Tab Commentary: Timber & panels -11,600. Brightwood Timber price list +8% from 1 February (letter of 28 January). Repeats every month until a rebate or a new supplier. Source: E01, E02, GL 5000.
Reopened Tom Avery's email of 5 Feb: comment every line above EUR 5,000, nothing below. No other comment written.
management_pack_2026-02.pptx: updated Summary, P&L vs budget table and Variance commentary slides from the workbook.
Sent 'February management pack' to Tom Avery with management_pack_2026-02.pptx attached.
Posted in #finance-close: February close done, pack sent to Tom. Only material line: timber (Brightwood +8%).

steps.text: Export the GL detail for the month from the ERP, P&L accounts 4000 to 6999.
steps.quote: GL detail export. Period 2026-02, accounts 4000 to 6999

steps.text: If the full-month export times out, use the split-export workaround. Not a standard step.
steps.quote: Error: request timed out after 120 s.

steps.text: Workaround: export 1-14 and 15-end separately, merge, and do not paste the boundary day twice.
steps.quote: export 1-14 and 15-end of month separately and merge, do not paste the boundary day twice

steps.text: Save the export as gl_YYYY-MM.csv and check its columns.
steps.quote: columns entry_id, posting_date, period, journal, account, account_name, cost_centre, counterparty, document_ref, description, debit, credit

steps.text: Replace last month's rows in the GL_import tab with the new export.
Check that no account shows UNMAPPED in GL_import.
Check that the sum of net in GL_import equals the ERP P&L total.
steps.quote: sum of net in GL_import matches the ERP P&L total

steps.text: Refresh PnL_vs_Budget and read EBITDA actual vs budget.
List the lines where comment needed = YES (variance of EUR 5,000 or more).
For each of these lines, filter GL_import by account and counterparty to find the entries behind the variance.
steps.quote: GL_import filtered on account 5000 and counterparty Brightwood Timber Ltd

steps.text: Search mail, chat and meeting notes for the cause.

steps.quote: Opened news site during the close.

steps.text: Write the explanation in the Commentary tab: cause, whether it repeats next month, and the source.
steps.quote: Repeats every month until a rebate or a new supplier. Source: E01, E02, GL 5000.

steps.text: Do not comment lines below the EUR 5,000 threshold (CFO rule).
steps.quote: comment every line above EUR 5,000, nothing below

steps.text: Update the management pack slides from the workbook.
steps.quote: updated Summary, P&L vs budget table and Variance commentary slides

steps.text: Send the pack to the CFO.
steps.quote: Sent 'February management pack' to Tom Avery
